analyzed_vuln.description: OFFImporter::InternReadFile trusts the face count from the OFF header (numFaces) and allocates mesh->mFaces to that size, but when parsing face lines it can stop early on malformed/truncated input (logs "number of faces ... incorrect" and breaks) without reconciling mesh->mNumFaces to the number actually filled. This leaves uninitialized aiFace entries in the allocated array. Later ScenePreprocessor::ProcessMesh iterates a=0..mesh->mNumFaces-1 and reads face.mNumIndices from those uninitialized/out-of-bounds-adjacent entries, causing the ASan heap-buffer-overflow read at ScenePreprocessor.cpp:148.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Input must be parsed as OFF and declare a positive face count in the header, but provide fewer valid face lines (or otherwise terminate face parsing early) so OFFLoader allocates faces for header count yet initializes only a prefix. Through Importer::ReadFileFromMemory -> OFFImporter::InternReadFile, the malformed mesh reaches ScenePreprocessor::ProcessScene/ProcessMesh, which iterates using stale mesh->mNumFaces and reads invalid face metadata, triggering the crash.
